amendment: Before any consumer development aggregate or API call, add legacy5_aligned diagnostic to separate budget allocation from record projection. Selection candidates and gates unchanged.
scope: One consumer-evidence milestone: cached BGE candidates through real retriever selection, search_knowledge, runtime observation and context admission, then short-answer evaluation. Controlled I/O adapters; not live SQL/Qdrant/checkpoint E2E or platform Formal Experiment.
development: all160 cached train cases from scenario-rag-20261023/musique-dev-1, including all distractors
confirmation: 200 seeded official dev cases excluding the300 previously exposed confirmation query IDs; selected before new method scores; fresh candidates computed only after consumer method is frozen

retrieval.floor_note: fixed benchmark replay floor, not calibration of production relevance threshold

runtime.estimator: existing conservative UTF8-byte token-unit estimator, not provider actual tokens

legacy5_aligned.projection: historical generic projection with tool cap also8000
legacy5_aligned.purpose: diagnostic control separating corrected category-budget allocation from structured whole-record projection; not method-selection arm

structured5.projection: opt-in whole records with paired references

structured10.purpose: explicit high-evidence scene within existing tool cap; not default change

no_rag.purpose: offline generation diagnostic with no tool exchange

gold_budgeted.purpose: offline gold supporting passages within same final budget, never a deployable retriever or guaranteed full-evidence upper bound

evidence_scoring: Evidence only credited for recoverable source records with source text, never IDs alone. Historical JSON previews may contain partial trailing text; complete recoverable-record metric is a conservative structural measure, not all model-visible span coverage. Report paragraph-hit,90% source-character proxy and payload bytes.

development_selection.selection: prefer structured5 if both pass, otherwise highest passing F1; none passes retain legacy baseline for quality adoption, preserve validated opt-in repair

confirmation_policy: Only baseline plus one frozen consumer profile and diagnostic no_rag/gold_budgeted. Grouped95%CI; no confirmation reselection. Confirmation failure remains negative. Do not report MuSiQue answerability performance from Ans-only data.
code_evidence: Stage source archives, actual job exits and raw public-data rows; no hash tests. Existing working checkout includes unrelated uncommitted changes.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
